section.heading: Enforcement; rulemaking.

para.text: The mayor shall enforce this chapter consistent with existing wage enforcement in the District.
The Mayor, pursuant to subchapter I of Chapter 5 of Title 2, may issue rules as necessary to implement this chapter.

section.codify:annotation: Section 7 of D.C. Law 25-274 provided that D.C. Law 25-274 shall apply 180 day after its applicability date.

Applicability of D.C. Law 25-274: § 8 of D.C. Law 25-274 provided that the creation of this section by § 6 of D.C. Law 25-274 is subject to the inclusion of the law’s fiscal effect in an approved budget and financial plan. Therefore that amendment has not been implemented.
